title: 빈 박스
suno_analysis_sp: K-Indie Pop. Clean electric guitar plays a syncopated, arpeggiated riff in eighth notes. A soft, dry kick drum and snare with light reverb provide a steady backbeat. A melodic bass guitar follows the chord progression with occasional slides. Male vocals are delivered in a smooth, breathy tenor. The arrangement features a subtle synth pad in the background. Key: G Major. Tempo: 95 BPM. Time Signature: 4/4.
suno_analysis_lyrics:
[Intro]
[clean electric guitar arpeggio, soft kick drum]

셔츠와 양말이 뒤엉켜
